item.title: Dear Abby: Husband wants to uproot our young family for new job
item.description: <p><b>DEAR ABBY:</b> My husband and I are raising our 7-month-old daughter together, and we generally get along well. I love him very much, but he has a habit that worries me. He's constantly on the lookout for a new job. This isn't necessarily a bad thing, but every couple of months he says he's bored and wants to work somewhere else.
